column3: Sat in third early - moved up to dispute front 2f out then went clear - asked for effort 1½f out - powered home in final furlong to win
Shared front spot early - edged in front 7f out - challenged back level 3f out - pressed and lost advantage inside final 2f - stayed on same tempo to the line
Settled at the back early - nudged up around halfway but still 5th and outpaced 3f out - stayed on at one gait late to finish 3rd
Settled off the front group - pushed along in 4th with little threat 3f out - stayed on same gear late - finished 4th

Shared the front early - lost the lead briefly 7f out then regained it - pushed along 2f out and lost command soon after - held third but couldn't find more approaching the final furlong - faded late to finish fifth
Settled off the pace - up in 5th at the midpoint - dropped away from 4f out and beaten a long way
Sat handy behind the front group early - driven into contention with a furlong left and shared second before edging up to the front runner - battled on to get up right at the finish

Sat close up early - driven into the front past the furlong marker - had to work hard when challenged inside the final furlong - stayed on gamely - caught by a short head near the line - held on for second
Settled midfield - driven and made ground into third with a furlong left - held effort to the line for third
Held up handy in the early stages - driven and dropped away over 2f out - kept on same gait to finish 4th
Settled in the pack - driven approaching final furlong - unable to find extra - finished fifth beaten 4.5 lengths
Slow to break - settled at the back - driven up before halfway - found nothing and faded late
Set the pace early - driven to keep advantage 2f out but soon overtaken - dropped away final furlong to finish 7th

Went straight into command - lost front spot after a furlong and sat second - regained control at 2 1/2f out - driven approaching the furlong marker and challenged inside the final furlong - responded gamely to hold on and score
Tracked the main group early - 5th at halfway - pushed into 4th with 2f left - up to 3rd approaching the final furlong - stayed on well but denied by a length and a half
Sat behind the front pair - third at halfway - pushed along with 2f left - closed on the front-runner a furlong out then unable to find more finishing third
Held up towards the back of the field - pushed along in 7th with 2f to go - stayed on same gear through the last furlong to finish 4th
Sat close to the front group - 4th at halfway - moved into contention with 2 1/2f left - into 2nd and pressed 2f out - found nothing more and stuck on for 5th
Held up towards the back of the pack - pressed for a run in 8th with 2f left - unable to close and finished under a steady effort in 6th
Held up towards the back - pushed along with over 2f left and unable to close - stayed on same gear through the straight - finished 7th
Settled in the pack - up to 5th under pressure 2f out - flattened out approaching the final furlong and a half to finish 8th
Held up in touch with the back markers - pressed for effort past halfway - unable to make headway from 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up at the back - never on terms from 2f out - finished well held
Straight into a share of the front - keen and hit the front after a furlong - overtaken with two and a half furlongs left - asked for effort but found nothing more and dropped away to finish 11th
Settled in midfield early - made progress into contention 3f out - hit front with a furlong left after a nudge along - powered away to score

Settled off the front runners early - moved through to challenge approaching halfway and travelling strongly with 3f left - pushed along and stayed on at one speed from the final furlong to finish second
Held up in the pack early - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - kept responding through the final furlong to finish third
Disputed pace early before hitting front after 2f - pushed along a furlong out then lost advantage - faded inside final 110 yards
Held up towards the back - fighting the bridle early - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on late without threatening the frame
Settled in the pack - made a short-lived forward move approaching the final furlong - flattened out and finished sixth
Held up early towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - unable to land a blow - finished 7th
Disputed front for two furlongs - sat second before dropping away under pressure with two to go - well held at the finish
Settled around midfield - pressed for effort with 3f remaining - dropped away inside final 2f - finished 9th well beaten
Sluggish start and dropped to the back - progress from 3f out - moved into third just after 2f out - hit the front 2f out - pulled clear in the final 110yds to win
Went wide from the off - up with the pace - driven approaching final two furlongs - kept on but no match for winner inside closing stages
Sat behind the front group - urged forward 3f out - kept battling to the line without threatening the win
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost front spot 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong - finished fourth
Sat handy behind the front group - urged forward with 4f left - lost touch when asked for effort inside the last 3f and allowed to finish in own time

Sent forward early under pressure - lost front spot by a whisker approaching 2f in - driven along soon after - locked together with rival 1 1/2f from home - regained command inside final furlong and stayed on strongly to the line
Handy behind front pack early - 4th at halfway - pressed for effort with 2 1/2f left - unable to close gap in 3rd spot 1f later - stayed on strongly late but denied by three quarters of a length
Settled up with the front rank early - edged in front approaching halfway - driven and challenged inside final 2f - overtaken 1f out - stayed on at one tempo to finish third
Sat close to the front group - 3rd at halfway - pushed along in 4th with 2f left - unable to threaten and stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Tracked the main group early - 5th at halfway - pressed on approaching final 3f - unable to make further headway from 2f out and stayed on same gear to finish 5th
Settled midfield - pressed for effort with 2 1/2f left but unable to close - held around 6th approaching final furlong and stayed on same gear to finish 6th
Settled in the pack - pushed along with no response over 2 1/2f out - faded late to finish 7th
Settled towards rear - still 8th at halfway - pushed along and unable to make headway 2 1/2f out - faded to finish eighth beaten 9 3/4 lengths
Held up towards the back - urged forward early - driven from over 2f out but unable to close - well held at the finish
Sluggish getaway and needed urging early - stayed in the back markers throughout - shown the whip yet couldn't find more inside final 3f - finished well held in 10th
Sat close up early - pushed along and hit front inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line
Held up in the pack - pushed along with a furlong left - finished with real purpose but denied by a nose into 2nd
Set the pace early - pushed clear again 2f out before being overtaken 1f out - couldn't find more late and finished third
Settled towards the back - pushed along and stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong - always struggling to get into the race
Held up towards the back - pushed along with 1f left - lost ground in the closing stages - finished 5th
Tracked pace-setter early - pushed along with 2f left - lost touch soon after - finished 6th well beaten
Settled close up in second early - driven into command approaching 2f out and edged right under pressure inside final furlong - kept finding more to draw away and score
Settled in the pack - driven up over 2f out and finding more inside final furlong - edged into second close home
Took a strong hold up with the front pair - made progress to second 2f out - unable to land a blow on the winner and weakened late to finish third
Settled midpack early - faded to the back after halfway - urged along inside the final two furlongs - found a bit late to close in the last furlong - finished fourth without getting on terms
Hesitant start leaving the pack at the back - urged forward with 3f remaining - unable to reach the front runners and finished well held in 5th
Set the pace early - driven to hold advantage over 2f out - overtaken approaching that point - eased back through the field in the final furlong to finish sixth
Went straight to front - pushed along with a furlong and a half left before edging clear inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line
Settled just behind the front runner early - still in second at halfway - pushed along with a furlong and a half left - unable to close inside the final furlong and held on for second
Sat close behind front group early - 6th at halfway - pressed for effort over a furlong and a half out - improved to 5th inside the final furlong and stayed on to finish 3rd
Settled just off the pace - 5th at halfway - pushed along 2f out and unable to close in 4th - stayed on late to finish 4th beaten 2 1/4 lengths
Settled in the pack - pushed along with no headway 2f out - stayed on same gait inside final furlong - finished 5th beaten 4 lengths
Settled towards the back - pushed along and made headway 2f out then 7th passing the furlong marker - stayed on at one speed to finish 6th beaten 4.25 lengths
Held up in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on same gait late to finish 7th
Went forward early - settled just behind the front group - third at halfway - pressed for effort with 2f left - unable to close and held on same pace to the line - finished 8th
Held a midfield spot early - pushed along and towards the back with 2f left - stayed on at one speed in the closing stages - finished 9th
Settled in the pack early - improved into 6th 3f out then pushed up to 4th 2f out - dropped back to 6th and driven with a furlong left - held on for 10th at the finish
Settled at the back early - pushed along with 2f remaining - unable to threaten leaders 1.5f out - kept on despite being denied room inside final furlong then allowed to finish in own time
Held up in the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left but unable to close - well held at the finish
Settled around midfield early and up with the pace after 2f - 4th at halfway - pressed for effort but couldn't quicken 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along inside final 2f - unable to quicken - held on late for 14th
Settled towards the back early - moved through and angled right approaching the final furlong - pushed out and finished full of running to hit the front close home
Tracked front group early - pressed for effort with 2f left and hit front approaching final furlong - overtaken close home to finish second beaten a length
Settled off the pace early - pushed along and finishing well from inside the final furlong - home third
Held up early towards the back - made progress into contention 3f out - pressed for effort inside final furlong and eased across left - kept on to finish fourth beaten 3 lengths
Settled in the pack - faded to the back after 3f out under pressure - rallied on the inside to close on the front-runners with a furlong left - held on same pace to finish fifth
Settled around midfield - pushed along over 2f out and edged right when denied room approaching the final furlong - stuck on same gait to finish sixth
Tracked the pace - pushed along and lost touch inside final furlong - finished 7th
Settled towards the back - pulling hard early - pushed along with 2f left before fading late to finish 8th
Set the pace unchallenged early - pressed for effort before being overtaken inside the final furlong and a half - dropped away close home
Midfield - took a wide path - dropped away from 3f out and soon in trouble - weakened before the final furlong and allowed to coast home 10th
Set the pace from the off - driven out inside the last furlong under pressure from a rival - held on by a whisker at the line
Held a midfield spot early - roused into contention 2f out and moved up into second inside the final furlong - kept finding through the finish - beaten a whisker into second
Held up early in the pack - driven and shifted right approaching final 2f - kept on inside the final 110yds without quite closing to finish third beaten three quarters of a length
Tracked leading group - driven with two furlongs remaining - unable to close the gap - held on for fourth
Held a forward position early - driven approaching final 2f - lost ground inside final furlong - finished 5th beaten 2.25 lengths
Settled midfield early - urged for effort with 2f left - unable to find extra and finished sixth beaten 3½ lengths
Sat second early and moved smoothly - closed on the front-runner turning in - urged ahead inside the final furlong - stayed on to score comfortably
Made the running from the off - stumbled at the last and driven along - challenged approaching the straight - overtaken inside the final furlong and stayed on at an even gallop to finish second

settled midfield - stumbled soon after but continued - shaken up in 5th turning for home after edging closer despite a check 2 out - third a furlong out but unable to threaten in front - held that spot to the finish
Settled off the back - urged into contention after the last - 6th turning in before staying on same gait through the final furlong to finish 4th
Settled in the pack early - improved to 5th with 5 to jump - urged along and unable to threaten leaders in 4th turning for home - stayed on at same tempo to finish 5th
Held up towards the back and stumbled 5 out - still ninth and unable to threaten leaders after the last - stayed on same speed to finish sixth

Handy behind pace early - errs at 1st - settles through the pack - into 4th and improves by halfway - blunders 4 out - shares 2nd but stumbles at last - pushed along with no headway on those in front - unable to find more inside final furlong - eventually 7th beaten well

Sat close to front group early - drifted right at the 4th - 5th place by halfway on the wide side - hit the 3rd last awkwardly - driven along and drifted right again 2 out - unable to find more from the last and well held in 8th
Held up in the pack - unable to make ground before 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled just behind the pace early - 6th of the field at halfway - checked when trying to move through two out - pushed along but made no headway after the last and held on well beaten
Sat close to the pace and drifted right at the 2nd - held 3rd approaching halfway - lost ground from 3 out - beaten a long way behind at the finish
Settled midfield early - pushed along and improving over 1f out - powered clear in the closing stages to score
Settled off the pace early - pushed along with two furlongs left before edging in front inside the final furlong - pegged back right on the line to finish second by a short head
Broke well from a wide berth to hit the front along the inner - pressed for effort 2f out and lost command inside the last - stayed on to finish third
settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed from inside the final furlong - finished fourth beaten 2¾ lengths
Held up in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on late from inside the final furlong - finished 5th beaten 2¾ lengths
Slow to break and settled at the back - pushed along with 2f left - responded to finish well and moved through tiring rivals inside the final furlong - eventually 6th
Sat behind the front group and wide of rivals - pushed along with 3f left - lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish seventh
up with the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - finished eighth
Held up at the back throughout - never able to challenge - finished well held in 9th
Handy early - asked for effort 2f out and briefly held off by rival in front - rallied strongly inside final furlong to get up on the line
Went straight to front - driven on and pressed clear approaching 2f out - drifted left under urging inside final furlong while holding on - caught right on the line to finish second by a whisker
Held up towards the back - driven into contention 2f out - up to third with a furlong left - kept on to the line
Held a midfield spot - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on without gaining much ground - finished fourth
Held up towards the back - driven from 2f out - stayed on same pace to the line without threatening
Settled just behind the front group - urged forward approaching 2f out - dropped away over a furlong from home
Sat close to the front group early - shown the whip and inexperienced with two furlongs left - lost ground inside the final furlong
Drifted left at the outset - held towards the back of the pack - driven with over 2f out but found nothing
Settled midfield - driven approaching 2f out - dropped away before the furlong marker

Shared the pace early - settled just behind the front group - third at halfway - pushed into second after the last flight - asked for effort turning into the straight - ran on to challenge up front inside the final furlong - got up to score late

up with the front group - moved to the front after the 5th - challenged at the 6th - up front under pressure from halfway - not neat 7 out - driven to go clear after the last - hard fought in the final furlong - caught near the line and held on at one speed

Settled towards the back early - into midfield by halfway - stumbled six out - pushed along after three out - unable to make headway and bumped two out - sixth approaching the last - stayed on at one speed to finish third

Sat close behind front pack early - needed a nudge in 5th - still 5th at halfway - clipped the odd fence four and three out - improved into 3rd before 2 out - asked for effort but couldn't get on terms after the last - stayed on at same speed to finish 4th

Settled midpack early - improved into 6th three out then drifted right at the second-last - pushed along in 5th at the last - unable to threaten in 4th turning for home - stayed on same gear to finish fifth
Settled towards rear early - error at 1st - midfield by halfway - pushed along in 7th after 3 out with little response - stayed on same gear to finish 6th
Settled around midfield - pushed along and unable to close before 2 out - stayed on same speed to finish 7th

Settled just behind the pace early - 6th at halfway - improved into 3rd with four to jump - lost momentum after a small error two out and dropped back to 6th under pressure before another mistake at the final fence - held no more in the finish
Settled towards the back - improved into 6th before 2 out - 5th after the last but unable to close - faded through the closing stages to finish 9th
Settled towards the back of the field - pushed along after 3 out with nothing left to give - dropped away and finished well behind

Sat just behind the pace - small error 6th - within touching distance in 2nd at halfway - stumbled 4 out - pushed along with nothing more after 3 out then faded before the following fence - finished well beaten
Held up in the tail of the field - minor errors at the 5th and 6 out - unable to find more when asked - eased out of contention before 4 out
Held up in the pack - errors at the 2nd and lost rhythm at the 3rd and 4th - fell back towards the tail - well adrift after the 7th - pulled up before the 8th
Held up in the back markers and scrambled at the opening obstacle - jockey sorted out stirrup issue and lost more ground - taken out of the contest before the 7th

Shared front spot early - went on after 1st - overtaken past 5th - back on terms 6th and stumbled - up in 4th at halfway - errant step 6 out then dropped away - faded from 3f out - eased out of contention approaching the second-last
Held up towards the back of the pack early - still adrift of the front bunch 4 out - found nothing more and was eased down before 2 out
Sat close up early - dropped to midpack by the 3rd - slipped to the back and blundered 4 out - found nothing more and was pulled up before 2 out
Settled in behind - dropped towards the back early - no response 4 out and eased out of contention before 2 out
Set the pace from the off - clear of rivals throughout - asked for effort 2f out and eased clear - eased out in the final furlong to win easily
Sat behind leader - pushed along over 2f out and stayed on final furlong - unable to close on winner
Settled off the front group - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at one speed inside final furlong - finished third
Settled at the back - stayed on same tempo from inside final furlong - finished fourth
up with front pack early - dropped away inside final furlong - finished 5th
Settled just behind the pace early - moved into contention with 3f left - asked for effort passing the 2f marker - hit the front over a furlong out - stayed on to win with authority
Set the gallop from the front - urged forward with two furlongs left - overtaken with over a furlong to run - couldn't match winner from there and settled for second at a steady effort
Slow to break - tracked leading pair - asked for effort 3f out but found nothing - eventually held in 3rd

Sat close to the front pair early - blundered at the 7th - fifth at halfway - pushed along into fourth after two out - unable to close on the front pair turning in - made headway from the last - went ahead 200 yards out and held on strongly

Settled towards the back of the pack - began to make ground after 3 out - up to 3rd before 2 out - pressed for the advantage into the straight - hit the front last - overtaken inside the final 200 yards and unable to find more finishing second

Sat behind front group early - shared 2nd spot at halfway - within a length approaching 5 out - edged ahead just before 3 out - pushed along and drawn level before 2 out - nudged in front 2 out - overtaken turning into straight - back in 3rd at the last - held effort steadily to the line

Set the early gallop before losing top spot - shadowed the front-runner then shared the advantage through halfway - still handy 3 out - pressed for the lead under urging before the second-last - up alongside 2 out and into the straight - overtaken approaching the final furlong - held on without finding more - finished fourth staying on at one gear
Held up towards the back - hampered at the first - pushed along and made headway two out - unable to threaten the leaders entering the straight - stayed on same gear to finish fifth

Settled towards the back early - hint of an error 6th - advanced into contention before 2 out - pushed along entering the straight in mid-division - unable to threaten and a small error at the last then finished without further response
Sat close to the pace early - through the pack in 6th and untidy at a couple - needed encouragement 6 and 5 out - pushed along in 7th before 2 out and unable to threaten thereafter
Settled in the pack for much of the way - unable to quicken approaching 2 out - held on for eighth beaten a long way
Held up towards the back - wandered left and scratchy over the opening fence - unable to threaten leaders and beaten before 2 out
Sat close to the pace early - not fluent 4th - 6th at halfway - pressed with three left but couldn't quicken and dropped away
Held up behind the pace - 7th at halfway - improved into 4th after 3 out - pressed but found nothing before 2 out and dropped away to finish last
Held up towards the back - pushed along with little response after three out - dropped away to finish last of the field
Settled in the pack - pushed along after 3 out with little response - dropped away steadily to finish last
Held up in the pack - blundered four out then erred again soon after under pressure - dropped away to finish last well beaten
Sat close up with the front group early - 4th at halfway - under pressure and holding no more before fading and coming down at the second-last
Close to the pace early - hit the front at the 1st - challenged 5 out - lost the advantage before 3 out and faded - pulled up before the following fence
Settled at the back from the off - clipped the 3rd fence and lost more ground to run last - taken out of contention ahead of four out
Settled towards the back early - still adrift approaching the 7th - eased out of contention before reaching the sixth from home
Tracked the pace along the inner - angled out for room 2f from home - driven to the front approaching the furlong marker - edged away under mild urging - won going away
settled towards the back - made progress into contention 2f out and pushed along a furlong later - kept on to the line finishing second
Settled at the back - nudged along 2f out and began closing from just over 1f out - running on strongly into third
Settled close up early travelling wide - hit the front approaching 2f out - pushed along and overtaken inside final furlong - lost ground late to finish fourth beaten 5 lengths
Settled in the pack early on eager terms - pushed along over 2f out - stayed on same gear from the final furlong to finish fifth beaten 6¼ lengths
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f left - unable to close on the front-runners - finished sixth
Set the pace hugging the inner - keen through the early stages before being challenged and losing command approaching 2f out - dropped away fast inside the final furlong

Held a forward spot early - settled just behind the front group and sat 5th at halfway - moved through to 2nd approaching two out - upsides the front-runner turning in - driven to challenge at the last - went ahead on the run-in and drifted right - stayed on well to the finish

Handy from the off - hit the front after the 1st - travelling keenly in the early stages - challenged approaching the straight - drew level at the last and driven along - overtaken on the run-in - edged left before finishing on one level - held on for 2nd
Tracked the pack early - 7th at halfway - pressed for effort but unable to close before 2 out - 6th at the last then stayed on steadily to finish third

Set the early tempo before giving up top spot after the first - sat behind the front group into the halfway stage - fourth at that point - asked for more approaching two out but unable to close in third turning for home - stayed on same gait to finish fourth

Held a midfield berth in the pack - small error 3 out before finding extra gear 2 out - urged along in 5th turning in without threatening the leaders - stayed on same rate from the last to finish 5th beaten 15 lengths
Tracked the front group early - 6th at halfway - pushed into 5th two out and 4th early in the straight without threatening - stayed on same gear to finish 6th
Settled in the pack - pushed along before 2 out but unable to gain ground - stayed on same rate to finish 7th
Handy behind the front group early - up to 3rd by halfway - pushed along and unable to find more 2 out - finished well held in 8th
Held up towards the back for the majority - pushed along with no headway before 2 out - always held - finished 9th
Travelled in mid-division - still 8th at halfway before finding nothing under pressure 2 out - small error at the last and well held in 10th
Held up towards the back of the pack - made no impression through the race - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack for most of the way - pushed along with no headway made before two out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - hampered by minor errors at the 2nd and 3rd - unable to find more from 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up at back of field - pushed along before 3 out with nothing left to give - well beaten into 14th
Held up in the pack - errs 4 out then pushed along and unable to quicken after the following fence - fades to finish well beaten
towards the back - veered right at the 1st leaving the jockey momentarily without stirrups - minor errors at the 5th and 4 out - dropped away 3 out - pulled up before the following fence
Settled just behind pace early - up to 2nd by halfway - pressed for effort in 3rd approaching 2 out - lost momentum after a minor error there - stumbled coming down and lost rider at the last
